notes: NASA PCoE official end-of-life is 70% of rated capacity (2.0 Ah → 1.4 Ah). The 80% threshold is the common EV warranty / replacement line.

modelCard.eolDefinition: Remaining useful life is cycles until discharge capacity falls to 70% of rated capacity (NASA PCoE official stop criterion: 2.0 Ah → 1.4 Ah).
modelCard.applicability: NASA PCoE constant-current 18650 discharges near 24 °C. energy_wh and duration_s track delivered capacity on this protocol; cycle_index tracks position along a cell's own fade curve.

stressModel.claim: Scenario acceleration referenced to 24 °C and 1C. Ea = 0.50 eV and the C-rate exponent 0.60 were not identified on the NASA cells.
